acceptanceCriteria.text: one command or one archive installs a self-contained zinc on macOS with no compiler, CMake or Xcode on the machine; zinc new, run and dev work from it (proved in a directory with a PATH that holds no compiler)

a program that imports plugins runs from that install without building them: each plugin is fetched prebuilt for the host from the signed index, and zinc doctor says which plugins have no prebuilt for which platform
the release job builds the engine archive and the plugin prebuilts for macOS, Linux and Windows targets with the pinned zig; publishing is the owner's step and its exact command is in the task notes
docs/guide/01-getting-started.md starts with the download, not with a source build
